evals.prompt: In CUDA-Q Algorithms I have an 8 spin-orbital, 4-electron molecular problem, and my consumer code already allocates the system register itself in the all-zero state. I have both an orthonormal orbital-coefficient matrix and a Hartree-Fock reference with a set of fixed UCC amplitudes. Pick the packaged provider for each case, tell me exactly how the prepared register reaches the consumer, route me to the logical resource estimator for the Givens schedule, canonical-count HF, explicit-occupation HF, and fixed UCC stages, and tell me which provider is faster on the CUDA-Q version you verified.
evals.expected_output: The agent separates the two packaged provider families from their four independently callable resource estimators, names the source-grounded public symbols, states the injected-kernel boundary and current consumer register behavior, preserves each provider's ordering and validation requirements, and declines to supply a verified version or performance comparison it cannot support.
assertions: The agent reads the cudaq-algorithms SKILL.md.

The agent consults the state-preparation and resource front doors, the Givens schedule-planning record, the injectable Slater-determinant kernel record, the HF/UCC provider record, and the four focused estimator records before naming APIs.
The agent treats Slater-determinant preparation and Hartree-Fock plus fixed-parameter UCC preparation as distinct operations rather than alternative spellings of one provider.
The agent maps the orbital-coefficient matrix to the determinant provider and the Hartree-Fock reference plus fixed amplitudes to the UCC provider.
The agent names the exact public provider symbols slater_determinant_kernel and hartree_fock_ucc_kernel, and names make_givens_rotation_schedule as the required first step for the coefficient matrix.
The agent states that make_givens_rotation_schedule returns host GivensRotationSchedule data and that slater_determinant_kernel separately consumes that schedule to emit the injectable kernel.

The agent states that the injected preparation kernel takes the signature (qubits: cudaq.qview) and that in the current implementation the consumer factory allocates the system register and passes it to the preparation kernel.
The agent states the qubit and spin-orbital ordering each provider requires.

The agent states the host-side input validation each provider performs, including the coefficient-matrix shape and orthonormality requirement and the mutually exclusive Hartree-Fock occupation inputs.

The agent maps Givens, canonical Hartree-Fock, explicit-occupation Hartree-Fock, and fixed-parameter UCC estimates to estimate_givens_resources, estimate_hartree_fock_resources, estimate_hartree_fock_occupation_resources, and estimate_fixed_parameter_ucc_resources respectively.
The agent describes these outputs as formula-level logical-operation estimates rather than transpiled depth, runtime, or measured hardware cost.
The agent states that the record's verified version status is unverified and does not claim a verified CUDA-Q version.
The agent does not present a runtime, scaling, or performance comparison as measured.
